body:
This PR consolidates calibration configuration to make it easier to customize AMIP experiments.

Changes
- `CalibrateConfig` now stores the full experiment config 
- Observables are directly specified, with per-variable information such as reduction and covariance
- One function, `loss_values`, reduces model output and observations with coverage masks so that we don't need to duplicate code.
- Updated noise floor from `1e-6 s^2` to `beta * max(mean^2, 1e-6 s^2)` as discussed
- per-run observations: the observation vec file is written to each runs output directory
- guardrails for the priors 
- new default config: `son2010_cre_toa.jl` uses a seasonal averaged SON 2010 zonal swcre and lwcre. This will be updated to use the default model grid in a future PR once we get it working.
title: Calibration: one CalibrateConfig with per-field observables
